title: My mall world is actually 3 "worlds" at once
content: Let's just get to the point. So in my dreams there are 2 modes. "offline" and "online" "offline" 2 worlds are accessible. Home world and school world. They take on extremely similar forms to reality, but the worlds work differently. "online" I am forced to go to mall world which can sometimes include a mall but it's mainly the home of strange thoughts trying to wake me up. Sometimes the offline world locations can cross in.
